injuries.name: Thomas Chabot
injuries.note: While Chabot was a full participant in Monday's practice, Garrioch noted that the 29-year-old skated on an extra defensive pairing, so a decision on his availability for Tuesday's game against the Golden Knights won't be made until after the morning skate. Regarding Chabot's outlook going forward, head coach Travis Green said, "I'm not sure if he's going to go tomorrow, but he's definitely close to playing. We'll see." If he ends up sitting out Tuesday, Chabot's next opportunity to return to the lineup will be in Los Angeles on Thursday.

injuries.name: Linus Ullmark
injuries.note: Ullmark was placed on injured reserve after suffering the injury during Wednesday's game against Florida, so we already knew that he'd miss at least a week, and it seems he's not expected to miss much more than that. The 33-year-old has a 7-1-0 record, 1.33 GAA and .945 save percentage in eight appearances this campaign. Jonas Johansson has been called up from the minors, and he's set to be Samuel Ersson's understudy for Thursday's home game against San Jose.

injuries.name: William Eklund
injuries.note: Eklund's timeline would seem to indicate that he will be out of action until the calendar flips to 2027, though it's possible he makes a late-December return if on the early side of his timeline. While the 24-year-old winger is already on injured reserve, he could be a candidate for long-term injured reserve if the Senators need the cap space to make a move.

injuries.name: Thomas Chabot
injuries.note: Undisclosed: Chabot was a full participant in Monday's (Oct. 26) practice in Vegas and is nearing a return to the lineup, according to Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia.

injuries.name: William Eklund
injuries.note: Ankle: The Ottawa Senators said on Thursday (Oct. 15) that Eklund is expected to miss the next 10-12 weeks.

injuries.name: Warren Foegele
injuries.note: Knee: Foegele sustained an apparent right knee injury after a hit from Jeremy Lauzon in Tuesday's (Oct. 27) game versus the Golden Knights, Bruce Garrioch of Postmedia reports.

injuries.name: Linus Ullmark
injuries.note: Lower Body: The Ottawa Senators placed G Linus Ullmark on injured reserve on Thursday (Oct. 22).

injuries.name: Carter Hart
injuries.note: Undisclosed: The Golden Knights have listed Hart as Out for Tuesday's (Oct. 27) game against the Senators.

injuries.name: Victor Olofsson

injuries.name: Kai Uchacz

injuries.name: Parker Wotherspoon
